market.title: Donald Trump — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
market.resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

marketBrief.text: Trump's odds ticked up this week after he joked about a 'fourth term' while wearing a 'Trump 2028' hat at the White House Correspondents' Dinner on July 24 -- Kalshi moved from about 2.4% to 2.9%, Polymarket from roughly 1.4% to 2.0%, within a day. The number stays low for a structural reason, not a political one: the 22nd Amendment limits a president to two elected terms, and Trump has already served two, so a third (or fourth) term would require either amending the Constitution or courts accepting a legal theory that constitutional scholars across the political spectrum have called implausible. That's the backdrop for this market's whole history -- Kalshi's Trump contract peaked near 11% last October on an earlier round of similar comments, then drifted down to about 1.4% by April as nothing concrete followed. The pattern so far: comments move the price for a few days, then it fades back toward its structural floor.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
